subject: MAP: compliance tie-outs (SOC 2 / SIG / DPA / retention)
messages:
From: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@fintechco.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Cc: security@fintechco.com
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood MAP and a couple of security clarifications

Hi Kimberly / Marcus,

Thanks again for the demo last week. The evaluation team asked me to pull together a concise MAP so we can align procurement and security review timelines. Two quick asks up front: can you confirm whether Redwood's standard DPA allows a 30-day data retrieval window for backups, and do you have a SOC 2 report we can share with our InfoSec team?

We'd like to run the evaluation in parallel with procurement to try to close before Oct 1. Can you propose milestone dates for SIG/CAIQ submission, SOC 2 evidence, and a DPA redline turn-around?

Best,
Alice
Alice Nguyen
Head of Platform Integrations
FintechCo

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@fintechco.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood MAP and a couple of security clarifications

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear asks. Attaching a first-pass MAP (MAP-timeline-v2.xlsx) and a packet with current compliance artifacts. Summary below and proposed dates so your team can slot them into procurement: 

- SIG/CAIQ: we will provide completed answers within 5 business days (target Aug 19).
- SOC 2: we can share the latest SOC 2 Type II report (2025) by EOD Aug 12 (attached). Any follow-ups from your auditor we can address within 3 business days.
- DPA: attaching our standard DPA with redline suggestions. We typically return redlines within 3 business days after we receive your markups. For the MAP, propose internal review milestones: Aug 19 SIG submission, Aug 26 SOC follow-up close, Sep 2 DPA final sign. That lines up with your Oct 1 close target.

Notes on retention/retrieval: Our standard DPA retains backups for 90 days; retrieval window for restore requests is 30 days for warm recovery and up to 90 days for archive restores. We can scope a shorter archive hold if you have policy constraints — Marcus (cc'd) can run the option for a 30-day total retention model and estimate cost delta.

Attachments referenced: SOC2-Report-Redwood-2025.pdf, SIG-answers-template.xlsx, DPA-draft-redlined.docx, MAP-timeline-v2.xlsx

Next steps: let us know if the proposed dates work and which internal FintechCo stakeholders should be included in the SIG handoff. Happy to jump on a short call if helpful.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Account Lead, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

From: Bob Chen <bob.chen@fintechco.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@fintechco.com>, security@fintechco.com
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood MAP and a couple of security clarifications

Kimberly — quick question on the retention language you mentioned. Our legal wants to avoid any language that implies we cannot request deletion of customer content sooner than 90 days. Are you able to support a clause that allows for on-request deletion (subject to legal/subpoena hold exceptions) and then a separate archival retention for backups? If so, can you mark that in the DPA?

Also: our InfoSec will need the full SIG workbook rather than a template so they can import to their tooling. Can you provide the populated workbook?

Regards,
Bob

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Bob Chen <bob.chen@fintechco.com>, Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@fintechco.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 11:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood MAP and a couple of security clarifications

Hi Bob — absolutely yes on both counts. Quick clarifications:

- Deletion vs backup: Redwood can commit to customer-requested deletion of customer content within 5 business days (subject to legal hold). Backups are handled separately; we can shorten archival retention on a per-contract basis to 30 days if that is required. I flagged the DPA where we can add the on-request deletion clause (see DPA-draft-redlined.docx).
- SIG workbook: attaching a fully-populated SIG/CAIQ workbook (SIG-answers-Redwood-2026.xlsx). That file contains evidence references and direct links to the SOC 2 report pages that map to each control.

Proposed update to map milestones based on your ask: Aug 17 — SIG delivered; Aug 20 — legal review kickoff on DPA; Aug 27 — SOC 2 auditor Q&A closed; Sep 3 — final DPA sign; Sep 10 — target for provisioning POC environment. That gives a two-week buffer before your Oct 1 close. If procurement wants to accelerate sign date, we can compress the DPA turnaround to 48 hours once legal comments are in.

I've looped in Marcus to model cost delta for shorter retention and Neha for SOC follow-ups.

Thanks,
Kimberly

---
Attachments: SIG-answers-Redwood-2026.xlsx; DPA-draft-redlined.docx; SOC2-Report-Redwood-2025.pdf

Bob / Alice — following up from the SOC Q&A: your auditor asked for evidence around key management and access reviews for the period Jan–Jun 2026. I've attached a short evidence packet inside the SIG workbook and included timestamps in the workbook notes. If you'd prefer a separate evidence bundle (pdf export), we can produce that by Aug 20.

On retention cost: Marcus will send a short note with a delta estimate for reducing archive retention from 90 -> 30 days (it is small for most customers unless you are storing large volumes of unstructured data).

Neha Kapoor

From: marcus_lin@redwood.com

Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood MAP and a couple of security clarifications — retention cost delta

Alice / Bob — attached is the cost delta for archive retention reduction (summary below).

- Baseline (90 days): included in standard pricing.
- 30-day archive retention: +0.8% monthly storage bill, no change to compute for POC.

If you want us to proceed with the 30-day model in the DPA, we can add the specific clause and an appendix with the estimated monthly delta (sample numbers included in MAP-timeline-v2.xlsx). Once we get sign from procurement we will lock the appendix to the contract.

Proposed next steps (short):
1) Bob to return DPA redlines by Aug 27;
2) FintechCo to confirm SIG recipients and auditor contact by Aug 20;
3) Redwood to stand up POC on Sep 10 (provisioning request required by Sep 3).

Happy to jump on a 30-min call tomorrow if any of this helps move the dates.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Solutions Engineering, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com
